**Allowed origins** (in `worker\src\index.ts`, `cors()` middleware, lines 19–34):
- exact match `http://localhost:4200`
- any subdomain ending in `.pages.dev`
- any subdomain ending in `.workers.dev`

Anything else returns `null` and is rejected.

**To add a custom domain:** edit the `origin` function in `worker\src\index.ts` (lines 21–28), adding another condition, e.g.:
```ts
origin === 'https://yourdomain.com' ||
```
or `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')` for subdomains. (Array-style origin lists won't work for wildcard subdomains per the note on line 20/`docs\DEPLOYMENT_NOTES.md` §4.)
